name: Pilisszentkereszt (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pilisszentkereszt (a blue shield with a yellow cross and a wheel, supported by two brown stags, with a white bird crest) above the names Pilisszentkereszt and Mlynky in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pilisszentkereszt arms with stag supporters and crest
